$comment: Private Pi code the pi-effect packages restate on purpose, recorded with its body by effect/scripts/pi-surface.ts. kind: declaration (a top-level name, or Class.member), calls (every call of the named function in the file), lines (every line containing the text). file is from packages/; sites are the files of ours that restate it. The P numbers are the rows of the coupling research of 2026-11-26.
